caption: The drawing depicts a segmented bracelet composed of six rectangular, gold-colored sections connected together to form a circular band. Three segments, positioned on the front half of the band, are decorated with raised, intricate, dark golden or bronze ornamental patterns, while the remaining three segments are plain with a smooth golden appearance. Attached to one side of the bracelet is a thin, double-linked chain, also gold in color, lying loosely on the surface. The bracelet rests on an off-white or beige background with no other visible objects present. There is a partially legible handwritten signature in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Bracelet
